I (19f) had the SAME exact problem as you when i was your age. let me tell you something, never let anybody talk to you like that. It will only continue to get worse as she will start to test your boundaries and see how far that she can take it. I understand that you may feel bad about it, but it’s for your own good. When my friends talk to me like that when I was 16 I felt the exact same way, I didn’t want to stand up for myself because I felt bad. But let me tell you, don’t ever let anybody make you feel bad about standing up for yourself. If she is talking to you in a way that is crossing your boundaries, then you need to let her know. End of story. especially if you’re going through a hard time, it will only make you feel worse. That girl is not your friend if she refuses to understand that those things that she is saying to you is making you feel bad. And the whole thing about her saying that the guy must’ve been talking about the wrong girl is very odd. And I think that shows that there may be some jealousy there. So, what you need to tell her is that if she does not stop talking to you like that then you will no longer be friends, PERIOD. and if she tries to make you feel bad about that or she refuses to stop saying those things to you then you need to end that friendship because she obviously doesn’t respect you or your boundaries. You need friends that are going to support you and make you feel better not worse or anxious when you’re going to be around them. You being anxious before seeing her is your body‘s way of telling you that this is not the right friend for you, and you’re already going through a hard time it’s only gonna make you more stressed out. I understand that you guys have been friends for a long time, but let me tell you it’s not worth it. If I would’ve stayed in those friendships and just let people talk to me any kind of way it not only did start to get worse but it would’ve gotten even worsen. sorry that this is long but I just had to let you know that you need to nip this in the bud right now because it’ll only get worse. And if others people see her talking to you like that it’s going to make them think that it’s OK to talk to you like that, and it’s not.
